title: Colored Surfaces
description: A music player layout that tints Shell parts with $layer, $hue, $chroma, and $contrast, with a brand-colored header, a colored full-height sidebar, a ShellMainFull intro band that reaches both edges of the main area, and a $sticky ShellFooter player that keeps focused tracks scrolled above it. Use it when shell regions need their own colored surfaces or a persistent bottom bar must stay visible over long content.
